facts.value: Examinations passed at a university are generally only recognized if they were completed no more than five calendar years before the start of the Master's program.
An application for credit recognition must be submitted with the application. Proof of all previously earned credits at a university must be attached.
Credits from a Bachelor's degree cannot be credited toward the Master's degree.
The ranking of applicants is based on a value that is 60% derived from the grade of the required degree and 40% from the grade of the study exposé.

The evaluation of the study exposé is based on the external quality and presentation, motivation for studies, intended career perspective, and proven knowledge in educational economics and quantitative methods.
Applications are processed through an online system provided and operated by uni-assist e.V.
The online application allows for the submission of required documents such as CV and certificates digitally.
Applicants with foreign qualifications must demonstrate German language skills at the level of the Central Intermediate Examination (C1 level).
Every preliminarily admitted applicant must take and pass the DSH-2 exam by the beginning of the lectures.
If the Bachelor's certificate is not yet available, applicants must submit proof of enrollment in the Bachelor's program and a preliminary certificate by July 15.
The semester fee for the Master's program is approximately 350 € per semester.
A preliminary admission can only be granted subject to the completion of additional Bachelor program requirements if applying with an economics Bachelor.
